experience.title: Experience
experience.lead: I started in support, moved through functional analysis, and today I build and run systems in production.

bullets: I build internal tools that make the paid media team's work easier.
I manage the GCP infrastructure: deployments, server maintenance and permission management.
I define infrastructure as code and build the CI/CD pipelines.
I co-founded a studio building custom web and mobile apps; together with the team I lead the functional analysis, design, development, deployment and infrastructure of every solution.
ERPs, admin platforms and mobile apps with payment gateways, subscriptions, real-time notifications and admin dashboards.
I automate deployments with Docker, GitHub Actions, Linux servers and reverse proxies, and manage the development and production environments.
I support clients through requirements gathering, technical definition and project planning.

utn.description: Three roles, from support to development

developer.title: Software Developer
bullets: Web apps, mobile apps and microservices for the university, across their whole lifecycle.
Centralized authentication with Keycloak for users, microservices and APIs: SSO, OAuth2 / OpenID Connect, JWT, Client Credentials, roles and permissions.
Generative AI with RAG, semantic search over vector databases and tool calling to query institutional data in real time.
Asynchronous queues with BullMQ and Redis for emails and notifications, plus integrations with LDAP, SIU Guaraní and REST APIs.

analyst.title: Functional Analyst
bullets: Requirements gathering with clients and users, turned into user stories, use cases and UML diagrams.
Functional validation with the development team and QA testing before every release.

support.title: Application Support
bullets: Incident diagnosis through admin interfaces, logs and database queries.
Role, permission and access management, following every case through to resolution.

Automatic recurring charges and a drag & drop quote builder

Beneficiary access that unlocks only if the account holder doesn't respond within the period they set
Real-time notifications and referrals with cashback
